_description: Fictional component datasheets for the simulated circuit. Used by the LLM as a reference to determine expected values at each node. No fault information is included here.

PSU-12V-3A.notes: Output should be a stable DC rail with <50mVpp ripple under rated load.

BUCK-5V-2A.description: Step-down switching regulator, 12V input to 5V output
BUCK-5V-2A.notes: Output must be stable DC. Ripple >80mVpp or deviation from 5V ±3% indicates malfunction. Switching artifacts at 300kHz may appear in FFT but are normal.

DRV-H-BRIDGE.description: Dual H-bridge motor driver, supply rail 4.5V to 7V
DRV-H-BRIDGE.notes: If supply (VCC) drops below 4.3V, UVLO activates and driver output shuts down. Normal PWM output should be near-symmetric square wave at 20kHz with amplitude close to VCC.

MOTOR-DC-5V.description: Small brushed DC motor, nominal 5V operation
MOTOR-DC-5V.notes: Motor requires at least 1.5V at its terminals to begin turning. Under normal 5V PWM drive at 50% duty, expect ~2.5V average at terminal. Below ~1V average the motor will not rotate.
